import html # Example template: placeholders for title and body BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Render a user-submitted blog post safely for display on a webpage. Parameters ---------- headline : str The heading/title of the blog post. text : str The main content/body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML ready for safe display. """ # Escape user-provided data to prevent XSS (CWE-79) safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Insert escaped values into the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
